worldcombat.skill.powersplit.summary: Link briefly with an enemy or ally. Each side gives half the budget of its next successful direct hit to the other's next hit. Borrowed power is never donated again. One send and one receive per side, within eight seconds.
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.use.0: Soften a strong foe's next hit and borrow half
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.use.2: Finish the exchange within the short link
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.description: Link with a visible body within %1$s blocks for %2$s. Allies and enemies qualify; each body can hold only one link.
Each side's next successful direct hit donates half its own budget to the other's next hit. Borrowed power is added after donation. Residual damage and self-payment are excluded.
One send and one receive each ends the link. Absorption, zero damage and cancellation keep the opportunity. Either endpoint ending clears both, and unused credit dissipates.
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.timing: Range %1$s blocks; prepare %2$s seconds, pay %4$s PP, recover %3$s seconds, cooldown %5$s seconds from commitment.
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.growth.0: At level %1$s, link range becomes %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.powersplit.growth.1: At level %1$s, link range becomes %2$s blocks.
Link within this distance only when a follow-up attack is available.
Compare the budgets of recent real hits, and link only with enough difference and a follow-up attack.
